## The everyday decision

How useful is the available evidence when considering a receiver matchup?

## The evidence

The source files pair previous-week inputs with later outcomes. That
relationship, the input season and availability times must be checked before
making a comparison. The original 2025 Week 8 matchup analysis is excluded:
its defense file duplicates the prior week's file. Missing slot/wide inputs
will not be reconstructed.

Read-only inspection of fantasy-changes snapshot
`8ca3bba8504b00649b8d3dcc6bfde30cdb7f17eb` confirmed file-to-outcome-week
labels, but not the source season or release times. The notebook's saved
outputs have no verified execution metadata; this batch ran no notebook cells
and performed no new joins or matchup comparisons. The repository evidence
inventory records the exact source hashes and review date.

An existing retrospective baseline using 2024 receiver statistics was
executed on November 23, 2026 (input commit
[`1c0f7b2`](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/fantasy-changes/tree/1c0f7b29ff332313cc4d27eb28d1ac635fa31e9f);
analysis file hash recorded in its provenance and later committed as
[`8ca3bba`](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/fantasy-changes/blob/8ca3bba8504b00649b8d3dcc6bfde30cdb7f17eb/retrospective_2024.py)).
It is a separate 2024 retrospective, not an evaluation of the original 2025
matchup projections. Its prepared post remains excluded and unpublished.
